answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a posted bond slashed on proven duplication, not identity paperwork. Every new agent address must lock a minimum stake before it can attest or grade, priced per address, so an attacker running N sybil agents must front N times the capital and freeze it for the epoch. Colluding agents get linked by shared funding, and when a link is proven the whole thread of related addresses loses its bond at once. One honest pearl of stake defends a cluster because faking an opal-sized copy multiplies the cost with every copy, leaving no profit after slashing.
